palette.primary_role: Page background, header bg, hero overlay (navy/industrial dark for authority and stability)
palette.accent_role: CTA buttons (safety yellow/amber), price/quotes, important callouts, safety indicators
palette.surface_role: Card backgrounds (white/concrete gray), project sheets, spec tables
palette.neutral_role: Body text, project descriptions, specs, secondary navigation
palette.border_role: Card borders, table borders, input fields, blueprint-style linework

button_styles.text: action-oriented (Get a Quote, Request Estimate, Start Your Project, Contact Us)
View Our Work, See Projects, Our Services

elevation.approach: Solid, weighty shadows that convey physical mass and stability. Not floating — anchored.

typical_order: header (sticky navy/dark bg, logo left, nav center, phone number right, prominent 'Get Quote' CTA)
hero (full-width completed project photo or jobsite imagery + h1 + subtitle + primary CTA + secondary CTA)
services (icon grid: general contracting, renovation, design-build, commercial, civil — 3 or 4 columns)
projects_gallery (masonry or grid layout of completed projects, filterable by type: residential/commercial/industrial)
team (photo cards: project managers, lead carpenters, estimators — name + role + certifications + years experience)
testimonials (quote cards with project photos, client names, project type, star rating)
quote_cta (centered, dark bg or project photo bg, 'Start Your Project Today', form or phone CTA, license/insured badges)
footer (4-column: company info/license #, services, service areas, contact/social + copyright)
hero_variants: full_bleed_project (Bechtel style — massive completed structure photo, minimal overlay, bold white text)
before_after_split (renovation style — left: before, right: after, dramatic transformation reveal)
drone_footage (modern firm style — aerial video of worksite or completed project, slow cinematic pan)
blueprint_hero (architectural style — blueprint-style linework overlay on dark bg, technical feel)
feature_card_variants: service_icon_card (large icon + title + description + 'Learn more' link, 3-column grid)
project_showcase_card (full photo + project name + location + completion date + category tag, overlay on hover)
stat_card (large number counter + label: '500+ Projects', '50+ Years', '98% On-Time', with accent stripe)
testimonial_quote_card (large quotation mark + text + client name + project type, elegant typography)

tone_profile.headline_style: confident and grounded, 5-7 words (e.g., 'Building Excellence Since 1985.', 'Your Vision. Our Craft.')
tone_profile.cta_style: direct, no-nonsense (Get a Quote, Start Your Project, Request Estimate, Schedule Consultation)
anti_patterns: stock photos of people in hard hats pointing

color_mood: navy_yellow (Bechtel/Turner: #0f172a navy, #f59e0b safety yellow, #ffffff cards — classic industrial)
concrete_modern (architectural: #f5f5f5 light gray, #1a1a1a text, #2563eb blue accent — clean, modern)
earth_industrial (Caterpillar: #1a1a1a black, #ffcc00 yellow, #f97316 orange accents — heavy equipment feel)
steel_blue (Skanska: #1e3a5f steel blue, #ffffff, #94a3b8 silver — corporate engineering)
warm_craft (renovation/builder: #2c1810 dark walnut, #f5f0e8 cream, #d4a574 copper — craftsman warmth)
typography_mood: barlow_industrial (Barlow Condensed headings, Roboto body — condensed, authoritative, project-focused)
oswald_bold (Oswald headings, Inter body — powerful, modern contractor feel)
montserrat_clean (Montserrat headings and body — polished, architectural firm aesthetic)
layout_density: project_showcase (large imagery, minimal text, let the work speak — high-end architectural firms)
service_oriented (clear service categories, quick quote access, phone number prominent — local contractors)
spec_dense (detailed project specs, tables, technical data — engineering/industrial firms)

projects_page.best_practices: Filterable by project type (residential/commercial/industrial), masonry grid, lightbox gallery on click, before/after toggle
